implemented: The ordinary chew path uses native integer object X and attack rectangles for already mapped ground families. At least 20 horizontal pixels of attack/plant overlap are required. Other unmapped states retain the legacy distance bridge.
Plant rectangles are shared by chewing and basketball: ordinary width 60, tallnut 80, pumpkin 60 with zero source X offset, cob cannon 140.

Default attack offset/width is (50,20); jack/newspaper/yeti (20,50); ladder (10,50). Reverse facing maps offset to 120-offset-width. Existing special giant/vehicle attack update paths remain separate.
Potted spikes are valid chew targets for mapped ground enemies. Contact is checked before searching supporting pots to avoid a scan for distant spikes.

Ladder placement starts without moving the zombie or setting eating=true. Completion finds a current live wall at the attack rectangle before adding the ladder and detaching its shield; vanished targets leave the carried ladder intact.
Physical lob visuals use source scale cabbage=1, kernel=.95, butter=.8, melon=1, wintermelon=1, basketball=1.1. Existing textures and display objects are reused.
verification: 864 controlled full-step native chew cases across six enemies, four plant rectangles, two directions and eighteen X positions.
Pumpkin protection, unsupported/supported ground spikes, and ladder target survival/removal controls.
Desktop and 390x844 viewport native Chrome: overlap 19 keeps health 4000 and zombie-walk; overlap 20 causes health 3996 and zombie-eat. Controlled diagnostics are not normal-play clearance.
testFixtureChanges: Chew/armor/hypnosis/garlic/airborne positive controls now place normal ground enemies at an explicit native contact position, rather than the old +20/+30 foot-anchor distance. Damage, health, cooldowns, pause and armor assertions are retained.
The pole post-vault and tallnut tests wait for bounded actual contact instead of assuming eating starts at an arbitrary earlier tick. Native pole jumping/bonk timing itself remains unported.
No player strategy, wave, random seed, price or cooldown was altered. Three old upstream-port golden snapshot assertions remain unchanged and fail after this intentional native-rule correction.
corrections: The older lob rendering code incorrectly scaled cabbage to .8 while leaving kernel/butter at 1. Projectile::Draw in the pinned source specifies 1, .95 and .8 respectively.

The initial scale test failed because its new helper export did not exist; that import failure is not claimed as reproduction of the old visible scale error. Chew and ladder failures were observed through actual Game.step before their fixes.
remaining: Ordinary pea/star/homing collision, source muzzle transforms and corresponding draw anchors still require a coherent port.
Native per-cell top-plant iteration priority and ladder climbing/height states are not fully represented by the current global food priority and existing-ladder exclusion.
Water, mini, rising, vault/bonk and other special movement/altitude/attack states still use previous approximations.
Current normal-play failures and three old-port snapshot mismatches must be resolved or justified with independent source evidence before release.
Current CPU/GPU/total-memory and real iOS/Android behavior have not been remeasured in this revision.
